mapper.sql: select application_id, visitor_id, host_id, host_name, start_time, end_time, reason, remark, status, approve_time, create_time, update_time, del_flag from visitor_application
mapper.select:
select u.user_id, u.nick_name as name, d.dept_name, u.email from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by u.user_id limit 20

select u.user_id, u.nick_name as name, d.dept_name, u.email from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
